Separate nodes: body, face, hair_eyes (character), weapon, robot, robot_screen (companion). The weapon and robot sit beside the character in model space (as in the source), so hide or reposition them. notes.note: Layla and Fanny share the same robot companion (jiqiren) and 8 emote face textures; the emote PNGs and the robot texture are byte-identical between the two source folders, so emote/layla and emote/fanny hold the same eight images. Preview renders (Workbench, textured) were checked from the front and side during the build; they are written to the scratch folder, not the repo.
